title: Start Here
subtitle: The ideas you need before reading any paper
description: Ten short primers that give you the vocabulary and intuition of machine learning. No math anxiety, no prior knowledge needed. Everything later in the path builds on these.
subject: ml

title: Foundations of Machine Learning
subtitle: Where ML came from and the classic algorithms
description: From Turing's question about thinking machines to the perceptron, backpropagation, support vector machines and random forests. The ideas every later breakthrough stands on.
subject: ml

title: Deep Learning Takes Off
subtitle: Neural networks that actually work at scale

subject: ml

title: Teaching Machines Language
subtitle: Sequence models, embeddings, early attention

subject: ml

title: Machines That Create
subtitle: VAEs, GANs, diffusion

subject: ml

title: Learning by Doing
subtitle: Reinforcement learning and game-playing AI

subject: ml

title: Transformers and LLMs
subtitle: The architecture behind modern AI

subject: ml

title: Making LLMs Useful
subtitle: Alignment, reasoning, retrieval, fine-tuning

subject: ml

title: The Systems Behind AI
subtitle: How huge models are trained and served efficiently
